questions.question: The unemployment rate is calculated by dividing the number of unemployed people by:
options: the number of people who are retired
the total population of the country
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (the total labour force) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is the significance of celebrating womanhood during the 'Raja Parba' festival?
options: To respect the menstruation cycle of Basu-Mata
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (To respect the menstruation cycle of Basu-Mata) है।

questions.question: The Railways completed the first trial run on the world’s highest railway bridge in 2024, over which river?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Chenab) है।

questions.question: Which of the following national parks was chosen as the action plan site for the Cheetah re-introduction project by the Government of India in 2022?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Kuno National Park) है।

questions.question: The Lucknow Pact was an agreement between which two major Indian political organisations?
options: All-India Muslim League and Communist Party of India
Indian National Congress and All-India Muslim League
All-India Muslim League and Hindu Mahasabha
Indian National Congress and Swaraj Party
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Indian National Congress and All-India Muslim League) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is the theme for the World Environment Day 2025?
options: Putting an end to excess water usage
Putting an end to excess vehicle usage
Putting an end to plastic pollution
Putting an end to fossil fuel usage
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Putting an end to plastic pollution) है।

questions.question: By which authority is the State Election Commissioner appointed?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Governor) है।

questions.question: Grahavarman, who was killed by Shashanka, the king of Bengal, and Devgupta, the later Gupta, was a king of which of the following dynasties?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Maukhari) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a multi-agency institutional structure of rural banking?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (EXIM bank) है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Swaran Singh Committee and the 42nd Amendment is NOT true?
options: The 42nd Amendment of the Constitution came into effect on 3 January 1977.
The Committee recommended five items to be incorporated in the Constitution as Duties of the citizens.
The Committee was chaired by Swaran Singh and was set up in 1976.
The Swaran Singh Committee recommended the inclusion of Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (The Committee recommended five items to be incorporated in the Constitution as Duties of the citizens.) है।

questions.question: Which of the following was NOT included as a separate religious community in the 2011 Indian Census?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Adivasi) है।

questions.question: The Central Information Commission (CIC) was established under which of the following Acts?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Right to Information Act, 2005) है।

questions.question: Which of the following newspapers was started by Bal Gangadhar Tilak in English?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Mahratta) है।

questions.question: Which among the following best describes NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) satellite launched in July 2025?
options: A deep-space telescope for observing distant galaxies
An interplanetary probe studying Mars atmosphere
An unmanned spacecraft for lunar exploration
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (A sophisticated earth-observation satellite) है।

questions.question: Which country hosted the 6th Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) Summit in April 2025?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Thailand) है।

questions.question: Kolihan copper mines are located in which of the following states?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Rajasthan) है।

questions.question: The Guptas issued a large number of ________ coins called Dinaras.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (gold) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Legislative Acts was responsible for the creation of the Federal Court of India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (The Government of India Act, 1935) है।

questions.question: Why is the Industrial Policy Resolution (IPR) of 1956, often referred to as the ‘Economic Constitution of India’?
options: It abolished private ownership in all key industries
It introduced a socialist economy and banned foreign investments
It initiated liberalisation and privatisation of major industries
It classified industries into sectors and laid the foundation for public sector-led growth
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (It classified industries into sectors and laid the foundation for public sector-led growth) है।

questions.question: Which among the following states have launched Rajiv Yuva Vikasam Scheme in March 2025 to empower youth from SC, ST, BC and minority communities?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Telangana) है।
